tagline: La forma más inteligente de comprar un seminuevo
style_notes: Brand name is always lowercase: 'carfiable'. The logo wordmark uses a custom gradient from cyan (#3bd8ff) to deep blue (#3b61ff) — always apply on dark or photographic backgrounds. On light backgrounds, 'car' is in gradient blue and 'fiable' in near-black (#111827). The icon is a hand making the OK gesture with a car inside the circle — use for square/app-style formats. Primary CTA blue is #3865E9 (solid, no gradient). Dark navy (#111827) is the preferred background for stories and hero posts. Photography should feature real people interacting with cars in a dealership or street context — warm, confident, approachable. Never use pure black (#000000) as background. Headline style: ALL CAPS, extremely bold (Black 900), tight letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em). The brand speaks to Mexican consumers aged 25-45 looking to buy a used car smartly. Competitors are OLX Autos, Kavak — position carfiable as more trusted, human, and tech-forward. Stories use the server-side render endpoint (POST /generate-story) for car listings.
